integrity: All exact formulas are proved for every prime-power field and positive matrix sizes using a canonical equality-partition quotient, full-rank factorization, and subspace-lattice Möbius inversion. Finite tests are checks, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Counts labelled finite-field matrices, specializing to binary formal contexts and their equality-based clarification dimensions; it does not count formal contexts up to isomorphism, concept-lattice sizes, real rank, or irreducible reductions. Searches cannot establish absolute novelty.
title: Rank-refined clarification spectrum of finite binary formal contexts
